paragraphs: Rabbi Yudan, in the name of Rabbi Yochanan, in the name of Rabbi Ini; in the name of Rabbi Shmuel bar Nachman: Rabbah, Kedoshim, chapter 24. He asked Rabbi Acha: Rabbah, the introduction to Eichah. In the name of Rabbi Shimon Shikfaya.
